about: Rule cards of t2: each card switches one rule off in a scratch copy of the submission (lab ablate).

cards.rule: Offers applied before the system change of 2007-08-11 were projected by the COBOL version: cents cut off, age from days / 365
cards.off: every offer projected like Neuron NG

cards.rule: Neuron NG takes the age at the nearest birthday
cards.off: the age at the last birthday
cards.where_label: days from the begin date to the next birthday

cards.rule: PS_SMOKE = J (German ja) is a smoker too
The offer uses the tariff, entry charge and growth rate valid on its application date
cards.off: the parameters valid on the begin date
